changelog: Affiliate settings import: files over 10 MB no longer fail as "not a settings file". Next silently truncated every request body past `experimental.middlewareClientMaxBodySize` (default 10 MB); it is now 40 MB, the reverse proxy's cap, which also unblocks the 32 MiB admin JSON importers and 15 MB theme videos. `SETTINGS_TRANSFER_MAX_BYTES` is now the admin JSON ceiling (32 MiB) instead of an unreachable 50 MB, and a `409 busy` import is shown with its own message (EN/TR/DE) (#3728).

en: Affiliate settings: larger settings files (up to 32 MB) can be imported, and a busy import says so clearly.
tr: Affiliate ayarları: daha büyük ayar dosyaları (32 MB'a kadar) içe aktarılabiliyor; devam eden bir yükleme varsa bu açıkça söyleniyor.
de: Affiliate-Einstellungen: Größere Einstellungsdateien (bis 32 MB) lassen sich einspielen, und ein laufender Import wird klar gemeldet.
